summary: Verizon ABS II LLC, as depositor for Verizon Master Trust, filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus covering a $1.0 billion offering of Series 2026-3 asset-backed notes backed by device payment plan agreements originated by Cellco Partnership d/b/a Verizon Wireless. The deal comprises $826.008 million Class A-1a notes at 5.14%, $65 million Class A-1b notes at compounded SOFR plus 0.45%, $68.12 million Class B notes at 5.34%, and $40.872 million Class C notes at 5.48%. This is a routine term ABS securitization shelf takedown, not a special situation.
